0022600156.text: The Clippers (1-4, 0-3 on the road) have lost four straight and sit 13th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific, while the Warriors (3-3) have won three straight, are 2nd in the Pacific one game back, and are 10th in the West. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Warriors are missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 regular-season win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
